title: Full File Cabinet
description: Customs paperwork for a single shipment can pile up — a commercial invoice, a packing list, a certificate of origin. Prove SwiftCargo keeps every one of them, not just the most recent upload.
successCondition: For one shipment, upload three separate customs documents (all valid PDF/JPEG/PNG under 5MB) via POST /api/booking/:id/documents. GET /api/booking/:id/documents returns exactly 3 documents. Querying customs_documents via `npm run db:psql` (select count(*) from customs_documents where shipment_id = '<id>') confirms exactly 3 rows exist, each with a distinct id and the same shipment_id — uploading a new document never overwrites or replaces an earlier one.
hints: There's no PUT/replace endpoint for documents — every successful POST is purely additive, creating a new customs_documents row.
Vary the filename and MIME type across the three uploads (e.g. one PDF, one JPEG, one PNG) to make each row easy to tell apart when you check the DB.
